Suit up, pounce into action, and save your captain!

Inside a heavily armored mech suit, you are a walking tank. Outside of it, you are just a fragile little cat. Welcome to Gato Roboto, a fast-paced, charmingly retro "Meow-troidvania" action-adventure that puts you in the paws of Kiki, a heroic feline on a mission to rescue her stranded spaceship captain from a bizarre, hostile alien world!

🎮 Play now on Crunchyroll Game Vault! https://crgames.sng.link/Dk3aj/iae4/ji90

Features:
■ Action-Packed Metroidvania Exploration Navigate a vast, interconnected alien labyrinth broken up into unique environmental sectors, including a high-tech lab, an underwater aqueduct system, and a scorching heater core. Scavenge for vital health expansions and weapon upgrades like the dash ability to access hidden sectors and backtrack through previously unreachable zones.
■ Frantic Boss Battles & Enemy Variety Put your reflexes to the test! Face off against aggressive alien hives, deadly tracking projectiles, and a handful of surprisingly tough, frantic bosses, including an unhinged, talking mouse piloting a rival mech suit. Learn their patterns, perfect your dodges, and send your rivals down in flames.
■ Piloted Submarines & Secret Tech The mech suit isn't your only vehicle. Hop into an underwater submarine to blast through aquatic hazards, or commandeer fixed turrets to shred oncoming waves of alien pests.
■ Gorgeous 1-Bit Retro Aesthetic Immerse yourself in a beautifully stylized, monochromatic world that captures the crisp, nostalgic feel of the classic Game Boy era. Collect hidden cassette tapes scattered across the map to unlock vibrant, custom color palettes to swap out the black-and-white visuals whenever you want!
■ Heartwarming Indie Charm & Humor Enjoy the witty, campy banter between Captain Gary and Kiki via her specialized radio collar. And yes, there is a dedicated meow button so you can express your feline fury at any given moment.
